lean.name: Formalism.DivisionValues.divisor_inequality_assembly
lean.note: Up to the stated errors, the eigenvalue and kernel factorial terms cancel outside the top places, as do the covolume and kernel terms in $\log\Omega$. Summing over the lifts and adding the last map’s term $-\sum_t a_t\log T$ gives the right-hand side of the upper slope bound.
